methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab represents institutional commitment to building deep AI capability outside metro hubs, creating a potential node for distributed peer learning networks that could spread fluency regionally.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops delivered by a Norfolk native explicitly targeting the technology gap signals grassroots capability-building through community networks, the core mechanism for distributed deep learning in underserved regions.

signals.title: ‘Shaping our future’: Company powering AI data centers invests $50+ million in Henrico, adding 200 jobs - 12onyourside.com
signals.signal_reading: A $50M+ investment in Henrico adding 200 jobs for AI data center infrastructure concentrates specialized technical capability in Richmond Metro, deepening expertise in the capital region but offering limited knowledge transfer pathways.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: AI pressure on Richmond's young workforce without corresponding training infrastructure suggests shallow adoption anxiety without depth-building mechanisms, risking displacement rather than capability development.

signals.title: George Mason student teaches DC-area seniors how to spot AI scams
signals.signal_reading: A GMU student teaching seniors AI scam detection demonstrates peer-to-peer knowledge transfer across generational divides, showing how distributed learning networks can build practical AI fluency beyond institutional pathways.
